exposure: labor induction at 39 weeks of gestation
time period (before and after the ARRIVE trial publication)
outcome: rates of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: Low-risk nulliparous patients from the National Vital Statistics System.
finding: Despite an overall increase in the rate of HDP after the ARRIVE trial publication, the HDP rate was significantly lower in the post-ARRIVE group among patients undergoing induction at 39 weeks of gestation.
